overview: AdixLoop is a dark neon-pink short-form video social app where people browse, create, and share reels.
features: Full-screen vertical reels feed with Following and For You tabs
Like, comment, share, and follow creators
Search and discover users, reels, sounds, and trending hashtags
Upload and post reels with captions, hashtags, and audience options
Creator profiles with posts, followers, and following
Inbox with likes, comments, followers, and mentions
Wallet with earnings, referral code, and UPI withdrawal requests
Settings with dark/light appearance and account options
